commit.message:
chore: e2e assert applyAiModel option exists

applyAiModel was relying on getByRole('option', ...)
with exact-name matching, which silently picked a
different option (or no option) when AI_MODEL wasn't
present in the autocomplete — bleeding into a
confusing AI inference timeout in the spec project.
Filter mat-options by hasText, assert the option
count is 1, and assert the input commits the value
so missing models fail loudly in the settings setup.

commit.message:
fix: swap client crypto.randomUUID for uuid

crypto.randomUUID() is gated behind secure context, so client
UUID generation threw "not a function" for operators accessing
Orchard over plain HTTP from non-localhost origins (LAN IPs,
.local, .onion). EventData construction failed before any
PENDING event could emit. Replace all five client call sites with
uuid v4, which uses crypto.getRandomValues internally and has
no secure-context restriction.

commit.message:
chore: seed nutshell listFees LAG with NULL

LAG(keyset_fees_paid, 1, 0) emits a giant spurious
fee event for the first row of each partition when
the operator restores a nutshell DB whose first
snapshot already carries non-zero keyset_fees_paid.
Switch the seed to NULL so the first row is treated
as a baseline (the existing WHERE fee > 0 drops it),
expand the JSDoc, and add two tests: a shape
assertion locking in NULL, and an in-memory sqlite
run that proves restored-baseline rows are dropped
while real per-partition deltas come through.

commit.message:
chore: pin custom-bucket date in keyset agg

aggregateKeysetsForMetric is called twice (issued
and redeemed) and getBucketDate's custom branch
falls back to Math.min(...data) when date_start is
absent — so the two piles could land on different
bucket dates for the same keyset. Short-circuit the
custom case to date_start ?? 0 before delegating to
the helper, so both calls deterministically agree.
No user-visible change today; removes a tripwire.

commit.message:
chore: widen watchdog freshness to 25h

The 300s window flapped on quiet mints whose
nutshell write cadence is much longer than 5
minutes (operators can configure once-per-day
fee calculation). Bump to 90000s to cover a
daily-cadence with a 1h buffer for cron skew,
restarts, and maintenance. Spec stale fixture
moved to ~27.8h ago to keep exercising the
stale path.

commit.message:
chore: expand analytics e2e matrix to all units/intervals

Generalises the mint-analytics pipeline spec from sat-only / hour-only
to all three units (sat, usd, eur) and all four intervals (hour, day,
week, month), skipping combinations the stack hasn't provisioned.
Extracts a `fetchAnalyticsRows` helper to de-duplicate the inline GQL
fetch. Also sets `MINT_WATCHDOG_IGNORE_MISMATCH=true` on the
cln-nutshell-postgres stack to prevent a shared-node false-positive
from freezing balance-log writes.

commit.message:
fix: remove double fiat division in tooltip formatter

The tooltip formatter was calling `formatFiatAmount(amount / 100, ...)`,
but the chart pipeline already converts cents→dollars upstream in
`getAmountData`. The extra `/100` produced values like `$0.02` for a
`$1.61` fee-revenue bar. Removes the division and adds unit tests pinning
the contract (input is already dollars, not cents).
